summary: Web app experiencing frontend issues: dashboard stuck on loading spinner due to failing API fetch handling, and mobile menu overlay/backdrop styling issues causing transparent background/page shift.
architectural_notes: Frontend should handle API fetch failures by terminating loading state and showing an error/empty state (avoid infinite spinners).
Mobile menu should include a full-screen overlay/backdrop with correct positioning/inset and z-index to prevent transparency and layout shift.
known_issues: Dashboard loading spinner never stops (frontend fetch for tests fails and loading state is not cleared).
Mobile three-dot menu overlay/backdrop becomes transparent and page shifts (missing/incorrect overlay styling or z-index/inset classes).
Tooling/session issue: file access blocked, preventing inspection of NavBar and Dashboard files.

existing_features.title: Fix the Dashboard loading/activation logic so the dashboard never stays stuck in a loading state when the test list API call fails in the frontend. The UI must stop showing the loading skeleton/spinner once the tests query settles (success OR error), and must show a clear error message with a retry action when tests cannot be loaded.

Fix the mobile menu transparency/blank-background issue by ensuring the Sheet (mobile menu) always renders with a full-screen dimmed overlay/backdrop behind it and correct stacking order. Add a proper overlay element or global CSS overrides so the overlay covers the viewport (inset-0), has a dark semi-transparent background, and sits behind the menu panel but above page content.

Prevent recurrence of the mobile menu rendering issue by hardening the open/close lifecycle: ensure the mobile Sheet state is reset on navigation and when view activation starts, and ensure no intermediate visual state remains if view activation triggers while the menu is open.

projectName: Fix dashboard infinite loading and mobile menu overlay transparency
